'''TheOutlawTorn Vengeance of the Bounty Hunters (AOBS)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[TheOutlawTorn]]
* '''Published:''' 6 November 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Lucia's List|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif|label=Agents Of Black Sun}}
* '''Strategy:''' Agents Of Black Sun
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 AOBS TheOutlawTorn DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Pretty straight-forward beatdown deck.  And as I always say, if you can't beat 'em, drain 'em (alas IT-0(V) and Fighters Coming In).  Card explanations:

IT-0 (V)-Force drains are +2 when you have a captive with him.  Major backup

Ponda Baba's Hold-out Blaster-Yea, I know, Jodo kicks with Naboo BR, but however much he kicks with it, it's twice as good with this hot momma.

Docking Bays-I mostly threw in DB's that were used in LS decks prominent in my area.  Force gen. and force draining too.

Hidden Weapons-I LOVE this card.  Definantly a cornerstone to this deck, especially with the objective flipped.

Imperial Artillery-<3 recyclable 7 destiny, not bad either.

Fighters Coming In-I hate decks that win by force draining, hence why I play BHBM, TIGIH, and AOBS only.  But I think it's a good backup plan versus an uber space deck, etc.

Basically, that's all I know to tell you.  Quetions, comments, recommendations?

*UPDATE*

-1 Combat Responses

-1 Evader & Monnock

+2 Small Range Fighters & Watch Your Back! (ty Shewski)

Shewski, thanks for the review.  I agree my force gen. is on the below average side, but unless vrs. a choke deck, I usually do fine.  I'd never seen SRF&WYB;, but that's an awesome card (I got two in a trade today :-D).  Ep. 1 Courscant is a given.  Though some of the weapons might not look good on paper, with all the bonuses and game text additions, they're deceivingly effective.
